Niu Shi Zhang - Introduction

Niu Shi Zhang was a sword-bearing guard in front of the emperor, responsible for collecting tribute. He used the shape of the smoke from the Huoyan Mountain to make the villagers pay tribute to him. The villagers mistakenly thought it was a sign of the Iron Fan Fairy, so they paid tribute according to the shape of the smoke, causing resentment among the people. Princess Iron Fan wanted to listen to Laojun’s explanation, and it couldn’t rain, so Niu Shichang begged her for mercy. The princess found out that Niu Shi Zhang’s lie about the tribute was a lie, and ordered him to return the tribute and explain. But the villagers didn’t accept it, and asked Niu Shi Zhang to persuade the Iron Fan Fairy to make it rain more. As a result, Niu Shi Zhang was caught in a dilemma.

It is a 15 cm long, mostly green parrot with a well demarcated red area on its head extending from the top of the beak, over the forehead to mid-crown, and extending to the left and right up to the eyelid margins. It has grey feet. The underside of the wings is a lighter green. It mainly feeds on seads.


Specimen: red-headed lovebird, *Agapornis pullarius* (Linnaeus, 1758)

name: Southern Cassowary
description:
オーストラリアに生息するヒクイドリは、世界最大級の飛べない鳥で、「世界一危険な鳥」とも称される。人に遭遇することは少ないが、鋭い爪を持ち、ひなを守る際には攻撃的になることがある。一方で、熱帯雨林の生態系において種子の拡散という重要な役割を担い、オスが育児を担当する珍しい特徴も持つ。人間との危険な遭遇の多くは、餌付けによる行動の変化が原因とされ、ヒクイドリに近づかないことが推奨されている。また、黒や濃紺の車に映る自分の姿をライバルと勘違いすることがあるため注意が必要である。

The cassowary, native to Australia, is one of the world's largest flightless birds and is often referred to as the "most dangerous bird in the world." While encounters with humans are rare, they possess sharp claws and can become aggressive when protecting their chicks. On the other hand, they play a crucial role in the ecosystem of tropical rainforests by dispersing seeds, and they have the unique characteristic of males being responsible for childcare. Many dangerous encounters with humans are attributed to behavioral changes caused by feeding, so it is recommended to avoid approaching cassowaries. Additionally, caution is needed as they may mistake their reflection in black or dark blue cars for a rival.

name: African Elephant
description:
This is a small, stylized wooden sculpture of an elephant. The figure is carved from a single piece of wood and features a smooth, minimalist design with simplified details. The trunk extends downward and curves slightly forward, with shallow horizontal grooves carved into it to suggest texture. The ears are subtly outlined, blending into the sides of the head and body. The legs are short and stout, forming a sturdy rectangular base. A single small hole represents the eye, giving the piece a quiet, contemplative expression. The overall surface has a rich, natural wood grain with a polished finish.

Source: Oweh Art Gallery. African Elephant, Ebony Wood, Private collection, Benin city

HIGHPOLY MODEL INCLUDED IN ADDITIONAL FILES

3D scan of the mandible of a small Indian civet (*Viverricula indica*).


The small Indian civet is a civet native to South and Southeast Asia. it inhabits holes in the ground, under rocks or in thick bush. IT has a rather coarse fur that is brownish grey to pale yellowish brown, with usually several longitudinal black or brown bands on the back and longitudinal rows of spots on the sides. It is 53–58 cm from head to body with a 38–43 cm long tapering tail. It is nocturnal, mostly terrestrial and it feeds on rats, mice, birds, snakes, fruit, roots and carrion. 

Specimen: small Indian civet *Viverricula indica* (É. Geoffroy Saint-Hilaire, 1803)

Ostatnio przeglądając internet, natrafiłem na ciekawą stronę, która z pewnością ucieszy fanów niezależnych gier – oferuje ona [spolszczenie Undertale](https://zagrajmypopolsku.wordpress.com/2024/10/09/jak-zagrac-po-polsku-w-undertale-korzystajac-ze-spolszczenia/). To świetna wiadomość dla polskich graczy, którzy chcieliby doświadczyć tej niezwykłej opowieści w swoim ojczystym języku, a także lepiej zrozumieć bogate dialogi i specyficzny humor gry.

Undertale to nietypowa gra RPG, w której decyzje gracza mają ogromny wpływ na przebieg fabuły. Gra słynie z niebanalnych postaci, głębokich wyborów moralnych oraz rozbudowanych dialogów. Oryginalnie napisana po angielsku, Undertale może być wyzwaniem dla osób, które wolą grać w swoim języku – dlatego fanowskie spolszczenie to idealne rozwiązanie.

name: Oranosaurus
description: Oranosaurus is a genus of herbivorous dinosaur that lived during the Early Cretaceous period, approximately 125 million years ago. It belonged to a group of dinosaurs known as ornithopods and was characterized by its distinctive sail-like structure along its back, formed by elongated neural spines. Oranosaurus had a long neck and tail, sturdy hind limbs, and shorter forelimbs. It likely fed on low-lying vegetation, using its beak to crop plants. Fossil discoveries of Oranosaurus have primarily been made in North Africa, particularly in Niger and Morocco. Studying Oranosaurus provides valuable insights into the diversity and adaptations of dinosaurs during the Early Cretaceous period, as well as their paleobiogeography.

name: Chim Chim
description:
Dot Hack Chim Chim. Bring your own Sphere.
Chim Chims (チムチム) are small, four-legged creatures found hidden in trees, giant mushrooms, and other places in the fields and dungeons of The World R:2. On the tops of their heads they carry an item called a Chim Sphere, the main power source for many machines (such as Steam Doors, Warp Points, and Mecha Grunty) found in The World. Power is measured in "Chims", a unit equal to the amount of power in a normal Chim Chim's sphere. Chasing and kicking them results in the spheres falling off of the Chim Chim and into the player's inventory. However, this causes the unfortunate Chim Chim to whither away into nothingness. One of the NPCs living in Mac Anu, Dr. Kubo, studies the Chim Chims' civilization as a profession. The energy in Chim Spheres is gathered from the earth, and when they have built up too much energy, Chim Chims gather in the Coite-Bodher Battlefield to release it in the form of a brilliant fireworks display.

name: PEKAKA EMAS (STORK-BILLED KINGFISHER)
description: Stork-billed kingfisher (Pelargopsis capensis), atau pekaka emas, adalah salah satu jenis raja udang terbesar yang ditemukan di Asia Selatan hingga Asia Tenggara, termasuk Indonesia. Burung ini memiliki tubuh besar dengan panjang sekitar 35 cm. Ciri khas utamanya adalah paruhnya yang sangat besar, tebal, dan berwarna merah terang seperti paruh bangau, yang menjadi asal nama Inggrisnya. Kepala dan lehernya berwarna abu-abu kecokelatan, sedangkan punggung dan sayapnya biru kehijauan cerah. Dada dan perutnya berwarna kuning keemasan yang mencolok. Pekaka emas umumnya menghuni tepi sungai, danau, rawa, serta hutan mangrove. Ia memangsa ikan, katak, kepiting, dan serangga besar dengan cara menyelam cepat dari dahan rendah. Suaranya keras dan serak, sering terdengar di sekitar perairan. Burung ini bersifat teritorial dan biasanya hidup soliter. Meskipun masih tergolong umum, populasinya terancam oleh hilangnya habitat alami akibat pembukaan lahan dan pencemaran air.

name: Skull of Zygomaturus trilobus (TMAG Z3554)
description:
*Zygomaturus trilobus* is an extinct species that lived during the Pleistocene (2.59 million to 11,784 years ago). A relative of marsuipals like koalas and wombats, it was one of the largest marsupials to have ever existed and would have weighed upward of 500 kg.

A complete skeleton of *Z. trilobus* was discovered by Mr E. C. Lovell in early 1920, while draining his selection at “Mowbray Swamp”, now called Mella, three miles west of Smithton. This skeleton was presented to the Tasmanian Museum later that year in time for exhibiting at the Science Congress held in Hobart in December 1920. 

**Museum Collection:** [Tasmanian Museum and Art Gallery](https://www.tmag.tas.gov.au/)

**Registration number:**  TMAG Z3554

Scanned by Ben Myers from [Thinglab](https://thinglab.com.au/) using Artec Space Spider. 

[Follow this link to learn more about this amazing specimen.](https://shapingtasmania.tmag.tas.gov.au/M/object.aspx?id=46)

name: Mantled guereza
description:
3D scan of a skull of mantled guereza (*Colobus guereza*). 


The mantled guereza (*Colobus guereza*) is an Old World monkey that lives in west central and east Africa.
It is diurnal and arboreal, found in both deciduous and evergreen forests. The head and body length averages 61.5 centimetres for males and 57.6 centimetres for females. It mainly feeds on leaves and fruit, but its diet is quite variable: It may eats bark, wood, seeds, flowers, petioles, lianas, aquatic-plants and arthropods.


Specimen: mantled guereza, *Colobus guereza* Rüppell, 1835

Inventory number: C 1586 

Collection: Natural History Museum University of Pisa

name: Rhesus macaque (right femur)
description:
3D scan of the right femur of rhesus macaque (*Macaca mulatta*). 

The rhesus macaque is a species of Old World monkey native to South, Central, and Southeast Asia. It is diurnal, arboreal, and terrestrial; it is mostly herbivorous, feeding mainly on fruit, but also eating seeds, roots, buds, bark, and cereals. it has an average body length of 47–53 cm with a 20.7–22.9 cm tail.


Specimen: Rhesus macaque, *Macaca mulatta* (Zimmermann, 1780)

Inventory number: C 3286

Collection: Natural History Museum University of Pisa 

Find out more about the Museum at https://www.msn.unipi.it/it/

Scanned and edited by Marco Merella

Perforated bifacially by boring and drilling with a handheld flake of Baltic Chert over 15 minutes. This is 1 of 30 teeth comprising an experimental reference collection for evaluating archaeological usewear stemming from the production and suspension of European Upper Paleolithic personal ornaments. This model was produced with an Artec Micro automated desktop 3D scanner at the University of Tubingen’s Material Culture Laboratory.

name: Koala
description: Коала (Phascolarctos cinereus) — це сумчастий ссавець, який живе в Австралії. Її щільне сіро-коричневе хутро, великі круглі вуха та невеликий чорний ніс надають їй впізнаваного вигляду. Коали мешкають на деревах евкаліпта, харчуючись виключно його листям, яке має мало поживних речовин, тому вони ведуть малорухливий спосіб життя і сплять до 18–20 годин на добу. Коала є символом Австралії та перебуває під охороною, оскільки її популяції зменшуються через втрату середовища проживання та хвороби.

name: Dogo Argentino
description:
The Dogo Argentino is a powerful and athletic working dog originally developed in Argentina. Known for its strength, loyalty, and protective nature, it serves as both a fearless guardian and a loving family companion. It stands 24 to 27 inches tall at the shoulder and weighs between 88 to 100 pounds. Its short, smooth coat is entirely white, though some dogs may have a dark patch around one eye. description:
3D scan of a fragment of the left dentary of the holotype of *Balaenula astensis*. The whole animal is estimated to have been some 6.5 m long.
*Balaenula* is an extinct genus of mysticete cetaceans from Pliocene (5.3–2.6 million years ago), whose distribution range was the Northern Hemisphere. A relative of today's right and bowhead whales in the family Balaenidae, it primarily differs from these extant giants by its small body size.

Specimen: *Balaenula astensis* (holotype)

Inventory number: I-12555

Collection: Natural History Museum University of Pisa

name: 蓝指海星
description:
蓝海星（学名：Linckia laevigata），是瓣棘海星目，蛇海星科，指海星属动物。

形态特征
体长30到40厘米，体重11到16克。腕五条，呈指状。常长短不等，外半段常略膨大。反口面骨板很多，为大小不等的圆或椭圆形，排列无规则。腕缘的骨板较大，排列成2-3个规则的纵行；口面的骨板较小成方形，排列成规则的纵行和横行。骨板上都密生圆形小颗粒。筛板通常只1个。体表多为亮蓝色或浅蓝色，亦有黄色、绿色和粉红色等，体色的不同是名为linckiacyanin的蓝色色素和附属的黄色的类胡萝卜素以不同比例组合而成的产物，管足为黄色。幼小个体多隐藏在珊瑚礁或岩石下，身体为暗灰或暗绿褐色。
皮鳃只生在反口面皮鳃区内，皮鳃区为椭圆形，多分布在腕的侧面，不见于辐中线；皮鳃区内的颗粒特别小，故较低而平滑；各皮鳃区的外围皮鳃孔常比中央者参而且大。侧步带棘5个，末端钝圆呈颗粒状，被口面延伸过来的颗粒所分隔。

栖息环境
栖息于阳光充足的珊瑚礁和珊瑚礁边缘的上层区域，水温22到26℃，水深0.6到1米。蓝指海星对温度、氧含量和pH值的变化颇为敏感。

生活习性
体表的蓝色是蓝指海星面对捕食者时的警告色。它们也会通过自断腕足的方式逃生，断掉的部分仍会再生。已知的天敌包括：河豚、法螺属、膜角虾属和宅泥鱼（又称圆雀鲷）属等。蓝指海星还是以其体内血淋巴为食的水晶瓷笠螺（Thyca crystallina）的专性寄主。此外，与蓝指海星共生的还有姊妹岩虾（Periclimenes soror）。
常固定于礁岩之上，夜间活动。
食性：同其他海星一样，是机会主义的捕食者和食腐者。捕食时翻出贲门胃，从外部进食。食物包括动物尸体、小型无脊椎动物和碎屑。

分布范围
分布于印度洋和太平洋的热带海域，从西印度洋到波利尼西亚东南部。
国内见于西沙群岛和海南岛南部。

繁殖方式
蓝指海星从外观上辨认性别较为困难，可以通过观察性腺和交配行为找出差异。通常于夏季交配，交配时大量聚集以提升受精可能性。圈养条件下多为无性繁殖。幼体生长两年后性成熟，妊娠期28到30天。野外环境下寿命可达10年，圈养死亡率较高。

主要价值
蓝指海星主要被利用与装饰个人水族箱和制成干燥的装饰品。以其鲜艳的色彩为民众和水生生物产业所知。另外，该物种也被视为潜在的制成抗肿瘤和抗菌剂的廉价原料。

name: primary syphilitic lesion ape
description:
Historical wax model showing a primary syphilitic chancre on a monkey’s face

size of specimen: 165.6 x 70.8 x 21.5 mm

3D scanning performed with the structured light scanner Artec Space Spider

Pathogenesis: After infection with Treponema pallidum, a painless ulcer (primary lesion, "hard chancre") forms at the entry site, accompanied by local inflammation and regional lymphadenopathy – collectively known as the primary complex.

Etiology: Sexually transmitted infection; in monkeys, usually via experimental infection or close contact with infected humans.

Epidemiology: Rare; mainly observed in medical research or historically in colonial-era zoos.

Clinical Features: Firm, painless ulcer on the face (e.g. lips, nose), swollen regional lymph nodes, otherwise asymptomatic.

Diagnostics: Dark-field microscopy, serologic tests (TPHA, VDRL), PCR from ulcer material.

name: Seahorse brooch
description:
**Collection:** Roman Archeology Dept.
 
**Inv.-No.:** [CAR-M-3468](https://www.online.landessammlungen-noe.at/objects/1353792)

**Material:** Bronze, enamel

**Dimensions:** 4,1 x 2,8 cm

**Dating:** 150-300 AD 

The seahorse is facing to the right, with slightly bent, short front legs. On its flat body, with a beige, enamel-coated underside, there are three blue depressions filled with enamel and outlined in black (now only two depressions still contain blue enamel) and four blue, stripe-shaped areas filled with enamel. The eye is punctuated, and the mane is indicated by crosswise grooves. Below the mane is a spine-like protrusion, and at the lower edge, at the transition from the front to the rear body, there is a small, two-pronged appendage. The tail fin is broken off. The hinge and the catchplate are only partially preserved.

This object was digitized through the 'Kulturerbe digital' program of the Federal Ministry for Arts, Culture, Public Service and Sport.

name: Flame-Colored Tyrant Hunter - dinosaur
description:
**New Theropod Species Unveiled: Tyrannovenator ignicolor**

In 2023, paleontologist Dr. Rafael Kim and his team unearthed a striking theropod specimen in the Kaiparowits Plateau of southern Utah. Named *Tyrannovenator ignicolor*—“Flame-Colored Tyrant Hunter”—this mid-sized predator exhibits unprecedented preservation of pigment structures and dermal ornamentation. Measuring roughly 7 meters long, it features prominent cranial crests and spine-like projections along its back, suggesting a role in visual display or intimidation.

Microscopic analysis revealed melanosome patterns consistent with iridescent and carotenoid-rich coloration, marking the first strong evidence of multi-hue signaling in apex predators. The discovery challenges assumptions about camouflage in large theropods and opens new avenues in the study of dinosaur behavior, ecology, and evolution. *T. ignicolor* stands as a vivid reminder that prehistoric life may have been far more colorful, and complex, than previously imagined.

name: Ibex skull
description:
The ibex skull presents a detailed view of its overall anatomy, revealing both functional and structural features. The upper dentition is clearly visible, with well-developed teeth adapted for cutting and processing vegetation. The bony core of the horns emerges from the top of the skull, showing the internal support that sustains their external growth. Large eye sockets indicate a wide field of vision, essential for detecting movement in mountainous terrain. The nasal cavity is also prominent, adapted to support breathing in cold and thin air at high altitudes. Altogether, the skull reflects a balance between strength, sensory capability, and adaptation to a rugged environment.

This 3D model was realized by Clarissa Bignoli and Erika Del Bene during the Universal Civil Service (SCU) at UniGe.

和名：原宝

英名：Map Cowry

学名：Leporicypraea mappa (Linnaeus,1758)　タカラガイ科　Cypraeidae

殻長：7㎝

参考文献：「不思議で美しい貝の図鑑」　ポール・スタロスタ、ジャック・センダース　株式会社創元社（2015年）

description:
This 3D model represents the heart of a rabbit (Oryctolagus cuniculus), created with anatomical accuracy for educational and scientific visualization purposes. description:

O modelo apresenta a identificação de alguns elementos ósseos, permitindo a observação de características morfológicas típicas da família Felidae, como crânio robusto e dentição adaptada à predação. 

A onça é o maior felino das Américas e desempenha papel fundamental como predador de topo, regulando populações de presas e contribuindo para a manutenção do equilíbrio ecológico. Trata-se de um dos principais representantes da fauna do Cerrado, um dos biomas mais biodiversos do Brasil.

name: Umbrathal - monster whale
description:
**The Dread of Umbrathal, the Siren Leviathan**

Beneath the ink-black waters of the Sunless Trench, where light has never touched and pressure crushes bones like glass, *Umbrathal* stirs. This whale is no gentle giant—it is a cathedral of flesh, its body riddled with barnacle-covered mouths that whisper in forgotten dialects. Its eyes are absent, replaced by pulsing voids that see into memory.

Umbrathal was born when a whaling crew slaughtered a pod beneath a blood moon, their greed echoing through the abyss. The sea answered. It stitched the dead into one, a leviathan of vengeance and sorrow. Now it rises only when the ocean is still, its song a low, mournful hum that infects dreams and draws ships off course.

It feeds on *remembrance*. Survivors speak of hallucinations—lost lovers beckoning from the waves, childhood homes glimpsed in the mist—before the hull splits and the sea drinks them whole. No wreckage floats. Only silence. And the echo of Umbrathal’s song, still humming in the bones of the drowned.

name: Borneo orangutan (Pongo pygmaeus)
description:
The Orangutan of Borneo is a great ape native to the dense tropical forests of Borneo. It is one of the closest living relatives to humans and is known for its intelligence, long reddish-brown hair, and distinctive facial features.
The species was first scientifically described by the Italian naturalist Odoardo Beccari in the 19th century, following his explorations of Borneo’s rainforests. Bornean orangutans are primarily arboreal, spending most of their lives in trees, where they build nests for sleeping and travel through the canopy in search of fruits, leaves, and insects.
Pongo pygmaeus is critically endangered due to habitat loss, deforestation, and hunting. Conservation efforts focus on protecting forests, rescuing and rehabilitating individuals, and educating local communities.


This 3D model was created by Clarissa Bignoli and Erika Del Bene during their Universal Civil Service (SCU) at UniGe.

name: Animated Styracosaurus Albertensis
description:
Styracosaurus albertensis was a dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period, around 75 million years ago, mainly in what is now Alberta, Canada. It was an herbivore, feeding mostly on low-growing plants like shrubs and cycads. Its most distinctive feature was its large frill decorated with long spikes and a prominent nasal horn, which likely served for defense against predators and possibly for display during mating or social interactions. Styracosaurus was about 5.5 meters long and 1.8 meters tall, with a heavy, muscular body that helped protect it from predators such as Albertosaurus. It likely lived in herds, which would have provided additional safety. Its sharp beak allowed it to efficiently bite through tough vegetation. Overall, the spikes and horns of Styracosaurus were crucial for defense, species recognition, and possibly dominance displays within the herd.

name: Bovine Femur  (Bos taurus)
description:
High-resolution 3D anatomical scan of an isolated Bovine Femur (Bos taurus).

This digital model delivers a precise and detailed representation of the proximal hindlimb osteology in large ruminants. It highlights key anatomical landmarks of the bovine femur, such as the prominent spherical femoral head (caput femoris) with its distinct fovea capitis, the massive greater trochanter (trochanter major) that does not extend above the head (unlike in equines), the deep trochanteric fossa, and the robust distal trochlea and condyles for articulation with the patella and tibia. It serves as an essential digital resource for veterinary students, morphologists.

Source / Provenance: This specimen is part of the anatomical collection curated by Professor Antonio Palladino, Professor of Veterinary Anatomy, Histology, and Embryology at the University of Rome Tor Vergata.

Suggested Use: Educational purposes, veterinary research, comparative anatomy study, and scientific visualization.

name: Nest of ants (NHMW-HYM-0031680)
description:
This 3D scan shows an exposed carton nest built by the ant species *Crematogaster dohrni ssp. artifex*. The nest is constructed from chewed plant fibers and encloses a small twig. Its delicate yet sturdy structure closely resembles the paper‑like nests of paper wasps. The specimen was collected by the botanist Heinrich Handel‑Mazzetti in the Manhao region of Yunnan, southwest China.

**Object**: Nest of the ant species *Crematogaster dohrni ssp. artifex* Mayr, 1879

**Inventory number**: NHMW‑ZOO‑HYM‑0031680

**Collection**: Natural History Museum Vienna, 2nd Zoological Dep., Hymenoptera Collection (Curator: Dominique Zimmermann)

Find out more about the NHMW [here](http://www.nhm.at/en).

Text by D. Zimmermann

Scanned&edited by A. Haider(NHMW)

name: Fossil brown bear (sternebra)
description:
3D scan of a sternebra of a  fossil brown bear (*Ursus arctos*). 
 
Fossil of a prime adult female skull of brown bear. The specimen was found in "Abisso Oriano Coltelli" cave (44°05'35,0 N, 10°14'47,0" E, labelled T/Lu 642 in the Tuscan register of caves) which opens at 1209 m a.s.l on the western slope of "Monte Alto di Sella" (Apuan Alps). The mammal assemblage collected consists of 486 investigated specimens, 127 of which belong to an individual skeleton of brown bear. The bear died from non-violent causes, probably during hibernation. The specimen was dated providing a conventional age of 6480 ± 40 14 C ka BP (Holocene).
More information : https://amq.aiqua.it/index.php/amq/article/view/112


Specimen: Brown bear, *Ursus arctos* Linnaeus, 1758

Inventory number: I17771

name: Striped skunk
description:
3D scan of the skull of a striped skunk (*Mephitis mephitis*).

The striped skunk is a mephitids that occurs across much of North America, including southern Canada, the United States, and northern Mexico, in a wide variety of habitats, particularly mixed woodlands, brushy corners and open fields interspersed with wooded ravines and rocky outcrops. Like all skunks, it possesses highly developed musk-filled scent glands to ward off predators. Adults measures 52–77 centimetres in total body length and usually weighing 1.8–4.5 kg. It has mainly an insectivorous diet, but it also includes other animals and vegetables.

Specimen: Striped skunk *Mephitis mephitis* (Schreber, 1776)

name: Spinolambrus macrochelos (Herbst, 1790)
description:
The geographic range of *Spinolambrus macrochelos* extends throughout the entire Mediterranean Sea. Despite this wide distribution, the species is considered rare across most of its range. It typically inhabits sandy or muddy substrates at depths ranging from 18 to 370 meters. Currently, limited information is available regarding the species’ biology and ecological role. 
The specimen documented here was collected on  July 10th, 2025, off the coast of Genoa (Italy) by Federico Vignati and Giovanni Roppo Valente at 116 m deep. The collection was carried out within the framework of the National Recovery and Resilience Plan (NRRP).

The specimen was prepared by Alice Guzzi and is now curated within the zoological collections of the University of Genoa.

This 3D model was realized by Clarissa Bignoli and Erika Del Bene during the Universal Civil Service (SCU) at UniGe.

name: Scimitar oryx
description:
3D scan of the skull of a scimitar oryx (*Oryx dammah*).

The scimitar oryx is a species that was once widespread across North Africa and parts of West Africa and Central Africa. It is adapted to harsh desert conditions and can survive for months or even years without drinking water. A grazing animal, it derives most of its daily moisture intake from plants.
The head and body measures  is 140–240 cm; the tail is 45–60 cm long and ends with a tuft. Both male and female oryxes have horns, with the females' being more slender. The horns are long, thin, and symmetrical, and curve backward (a distinctive feature of this species).


Specimen: Scimitar oryx, *Oryx dammah* (Cretzschmar, 1826)

Inventory number: C 1278

Collection: Natural History Museum University of Pisa 

Find out more about the Museum at https://www.msn.unipi.it/it/

name: Asian Elephant
description: The Asian elephant (Elephas maximus), also known as the Asiatic elephant, is a species of elephant distributed throughout the Indian subcontinent and Southeast Asia, from India in the west to Borneo in the east, and Nepal in the north to Sumatra in the south. Three subspecies are recognised—E. m. maximus, E. m. indicus and E. m. sumatranus. The Asian elephant is characterised by its long trunk with a single finger-like processing; large tusks in males; laterally folded large ears but smaller in contrast to African elephants; and wrinkled grey skin. The skin is smoother than African elephants and may be depigmented on the trunk, ears or neck. Adult males average 4 tonnes (4.4 short tons) in weight, and females 2.7 t (3.0 short tons).

name: Co warto wiedzieć o spolszczeniu Tropico 6?
description:
Ostatnio trafiłem na ciekawą stronę, która z pewnością zainteresuje fanów serii Tropico – znalazłem tam [spolszczenie do Tropico 6](https://grajmypopolsku.blogspot.com/2024/10/tropico-6-jak-zagrac-po-polsku.html). To świetna wiadomość dla osób, które chciałyby zarządzać swoją wyspą i podejmować strategiczne decyzje w pełni po polsku, co na pewno ułatwia zrozumienie wszystkich zawiłości gry.

Tropico 6 to gra strategiczna, w której wcielamy się w rolę El Presidente, dyktatora (lub dobroczyńcy) rządzącego fikcyjną karaibską wyspą. Gra oferuje rozbudowane mechaniki zarządzania, dyplomacji i ekonomii, a także mnóstwo humoru i satyry politycznej. Spolszczenie jest szczególnie przydatne, ponieważ wiele ważnych informacji i wskazówek znajduje się w dialogach oraz opisach, a ich pełne zrozumienie znacząco wpływa na skuteczność prowadzenia rozgrywki.

**Dato curioso:**
La tortuga caretta es conocida por su capacidad para recorrer grandes distancias en el océano, y es una de las tortugas marinas más comunes en las costas del mundo. Además, es famosa por su comportamiento migratorio, ya que puede viajar miles de kilómetros.

The male flame robin has a bright orange-red breast. The female is light brown with a small white forehead spot. After breeding, these robins form small mixed flocks and move out into farmland. Here they perch on thistles or rocks, searching for food on the ground below, then dropping down to catch their prey. They often flick their wings when perched.
Length: 135 mm 

QVM:1981:2:0587

name: Diprotodon skull with jaw muscles
description:
This is a reconstructed and simplified model of the cranium of *Diprotodon optatum* (NMV P31299) from the collection of Museum Victoria (https://museumvictoria.com.au/melbournemuseum/discoverycentre/600-million-years/timeline/quaternary/diprotodon/). This fossil was recovered from Pleistocene sediments at Bacchus Marsh in Victoria, Australia. Diprotodon is the largest marsupial known and could have weighed over three tons.

This model accompanies an article published in PeerJ (https://peerj.com/articles/514/) that describes the cranium, and jaw muscles, reconstructed from comparisons with wombats, koalas and macropods. Temporalis in red, masseter in blue, lateral pterygoid in orange, and medial pterygoid in yellow.

Sharp, A. C. (2014). Three dimensional digital reconstruction of the jaw adductor musculature of the extinct marsupial giant Diprotodon optatum. PeerJ, 2, e514. https://doi.org/10.7717/peerj.514

Prepared by Paolo Savi in 1825, it depicts a wounded wild boar attacked by two dogs, one of which is wounded by the wild boar in its attempt to defend itself. The wild boar, of considerable size and originating from the San Rossore estate, was donated to the Museo Pisano by the Grand Duke of Tuscany in 1824. 


Specimen: wild boar, *Sus scrofa* Linnaeus, 1758

name: Leona Baena, S. V a.C. MAN. España.
description:
Leona de Baena, Córdoba, España.

Actualmente: Museo Arqueológicon Nacional, Madrid.

Cultura Ibérica.

S. V a. C.

Piedra caliza.

Escultura de una leona tumbada en actitud amenazante, boca entreabierta con una dentadura con piezas rectangulares y anchas. Ojos de forma ovalada y orejas con forma lanceolada. 
El animal está sentado sobre las cuatro patas. Se conservan íntegras las dos traseras, en las delanteras, falta la parte de las garras. Toda la pieza apoya sobre un pedestal. 

Está tallada únicamente por su cara frontal ya que la posterior se adosaría a uno de los lados del monumento funerario que protegía. 
La presencia de esculturas de animales reales o míticos protegiendo simbólicamente los monumentos funerarios, correspondientes a personajes destacados, era una de las características de las necrópolis ibéricas de los siglos VI y V a.C. 
Vemos influencias orientales y griegas en las técnicas y la estética escultórica.

name: Orang Utan
description:
Orangutan adalah primata besar yang berasal dari hutan hujan tropis Indonesia. Hewan ini dikenal memiliki lengan panjang, bulu cokelat kemerahan, dan kecerdasan tinggi. Orangutan sering hidup di pepohonan untuk mencari buah, daun, dan makanan lainnya. Habitat alaminya berada di hutan Kalimantan dan Sumatra, dan termasuk satwa yang dilindungi karena populasinya semakin berkurang.

Model 3D ini cocok untuk edukasi satwa Indonesia, aplikasi AR/VR.

The Orangutan is a great ape native to the tropical rainforests of Indonesia. It is known for its long arms, reddish-brown fur, and high intelligence. Orangutans spend most of their time in trees searching for fruits and leaves. Their natural habitat is in the forests of Borneo and Sumatra.

This 3D model is suitable for wildlife education, AR/VR projects, animations, biology learning, or nature-themed games.

name: Tasmanian pademelon
description:
3D scan of the skull of a Tasmanian pademelon (*Thylogale billardierii*).

The Tasmanian pademelon is the sole species of pademelon found in Tasmania, and was formerly found throughout southeastern Australia. Males weights around 6.5 kg and measures 70-120 cm in length (including the 30-45 cm tail). It lives mainly in rainforest, sclerophyll forest, and scrubland, although wet gullies in dry open eucalyptus forest are also used. It is a herbivore that feeds on a wide variety of plants, from herbs, green shoots and grass, to some nectar-bearing flowers.


Specimen: Tasmanian pademelon, *Thylogale billardierii* (Desmarest, 1822)

name: Styracosaurus V2
description:
All models are available for sale on my cgtrader link on my page!
Styracosaurus was a herbivorous ceratopsid dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period, approximately 75 to 72 million years ago. It was known for its striking appearance, with a large frill adorned with six long spikes, a prominent nasal horn, and smaller horns on its cheeks. Styracosaurus measured about 5.5 meters (18 feet) in length and weighed around 3 tons. Its frill and horns likely served as both a defense against predators like tyrannosaurs and as a display for mating or dominance. Fossils of Styracosaurus have been found in North America, particularly in Alberta, Canada, making it one of the iconic horned dinosaurs.

Depictions of Gajah Mina can vary, but common features include the head and tusks of an elephant combined with a fish-like or serpentine body, fins, and often a decorative saddle or ornamentation suggesting its divine or royal association. This mythical creature often symbolizes strength, wisdom, and a connection to ancient powers.

3D model of an equine calcaneus developed from a real anatomical specimen for educational use in Veterinary Anatomy. The calcaneus is a tarsal bone of the pelvic limb and is relevant for the study of osteology, comparative anatomy, and anatomical morphology in horses.

This model was prepared for digital visualization and 3D printing. It can be used as a complementary teaching resource in practical anatomy classes. For physical reproduction, FDM 3D printing with PLA filament is recommended, with print orientation, supports, and infill adjusted according to the slicing software.

This model is part of a project focused on the development and dissemination of 3D animal bone models to support practical teaching in Veterinary Anatomy at IF Goiano — Campus Urutaí.

name: Orang Mbasuh Tangan
description:
Berikut deskripsi tentang membasuh tangan saat wudhu:

Syarat

1. Air wudhu harus suci dan tidak tercemar.
2. Tangan harus dalam keadaan bersih dan tidak terdapat benda yang menghalangi air.
3. Pastikan tidak ada halangan seperti perhiasan, cat, atau kotoran.

Tata Cara

1. Masukkan tangan kanan ke air wudhu.
2. Basuh telapak tangan kanan hingga pergelangan tangan.
3. Gosok-gosokkan jari-jari dan telapak tangan.
4. Ulangi langkah yang sama untuk tangan kiri.
5. Pastikan air mengenai seluruh permukaan tangan.
6. Bilas tangan hingga bersih.

Ketentuan

1. Membasuh tangan dilakukan sebanyak 3 kali.
2. Harus dilakukan setelah membasuh wajah.
3. Tangan kiri dibasuh setelah tangan kanan.
4. Jangan lupa membersihkan sela-sela jari.

Sunnah

1. Membasuh tangan sebelum memulai wudhu.
2. Menggosok-gosokkan jari-jari.
3. Membasuh tangan hingga pergelangan tangan.

Faedah

1. Membersihkan tangan dari kotoran.
2. Menghilangkan bakteri dan kuman.
3. Meningkatkan kesucian dan kebersihan.
4. Membantu menyempurnakan wudhu.

description:
The leopard is one of the five extant cat species in the genus Panthera. It has a pale yellowish to dark golden fur with dark spots grouped in rosettes. Its body is slender and muscular, reaching a length of 92–183 cm (36–72 in) with a 66–102 cm (26–40 in) long tail and a shoulder height of 60–70 cm (24–28 in). Males typically weigh 30.9–72 kg (68–159 lb), and females 20.5–43 kg (45–95 lb).

The leopard is adapted to a variety of habitats ranging from rainforest to steppe, including arid and montane areas. It is an opportunistic predator, hunting mostly ungulates and primates. It relies on its spotted pattern for camouflage as it stalks and ambushes its prey, which it sometimes drags up a tree. It is a solitary animal outside the mating season and when raising cubs. Females usually give birth to a litter of 2–4 cubs once in 15–24 months. Both male and female leopards typically reach sexual maturity at the age 2–2.5 years.

Recognized by their humped shoulders, shaggy dark brown coats, and curved horns, bison are powerful grazers that shape grassland ecosystems. They can weigh over 2,000 pounds yet run up to 35 mph. Thanks to conservation efforts, bison have rebounded and are celebrated as symbols of resilience and the American frontier.
